verses.en: When Earth is shaken with her (final) earthquake
And Earth yieldeth up her burdens
And man saith: What aileth her
That day she will relate her chronicles

verses.ar: يَوۡمَئِذࣲ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتࣰ ا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
verses.en: That day mankind will issue forth in scattered groups to be shown their deeds

verses.ar: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرࣰ ا يَرَهُۥ
verses.en: And whoso doeth good an atom's weight will see it then

verses.ar: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةࣲ شَرࣰّ ا يَرَهُۥ
verses.en: And whoso doeth ill an atom's weight will see it then
